shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && sed -n '1,240p' ../ticket.md && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,260p' ../round-brief.md; fi && sed -n '1,260p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "wc -l ../round-brief.md; rg -n \"FAIL|Error|Assertion|expected|received|registry|spec link|Spec|×|✕\" ../round-brief.md; git status --short --branch; sed -n '1,280p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts; sed -n '1,320p' specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md; sed -n '1,220p' .lore/test-commands.yml"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"specs/.*#[0-9]+|@spec|spec:\" src --glob '*.test.ts' | head -80; sed -n '1,280p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts; cat package.json | sed -n '1,180p'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md .lore/dod.md
if [ -f scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs ]; then node scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs; fi
git diff --check
git diff -- .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md
git diff --check
git status --short
git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts
git commit -m "test valid tool input passthrough"
git push origin HEAD
git fetch origin main
git merge --no-edit origin/main
git push origin HEAD
git status --short --branch'
